description: Use this during a Gauntlet run to call one sandbox tool in the current job. Inputs: gauntlet_id, tool and args. Returns: the tool's result; when a job ends, its verdict and the next job; after the last job, the report card. Limits: each job's tool-call limit (in limits); only the sandbox is touched.
name: gauntlet_act
title: Act in the Forge Gauntlet
